claim: Paper protocol retains a disclosed ambiguity
allowed_wording: The local work uses an explicitly declared target-prefix protocol.
prohibited_wording: The paper protocol was uniquely and fully reconstructed.

claim: Paper-style fusion exhibited a catastrophic output mode
metric: 25 catastrophic validation predictions across 10 paper-fusion runs
allowed_wording: Paper-style fusion produced predefined catastrophic validation predictions under the audited protocol.
prohibited_wording: The original method fails on every battery or dataset.

claim: Bounded residual fusion removed the observed catastrophic mode
metric: catastrophic count 25 to 0 while the accuracy gate remained unmet
allowed_wording: Bounded residual fusion eliminated the predefined catastrophic predictions in the evaluated validation experiments.
prohibited_wording: Bounded residual fusion solved SOH estimation or generalization.

claim: Shorter fusion sequences were not a primary remedy
metric: seq=4 increased usable samples but no configuration qualified
allowed_wording: Sequence shortening was not a primary remedy in the fixed small-sample diagnostic.
prohibited_wording: The selected sequence length is generally optimal.

claim: Fusion capacity alone did not explain the failure
metric: parameters per sample decreased from 1793 to 3.8 without qualification
allowed_wording: Capacity reduction alone did not explain the observed failure.
prohibited_wording: Model size is irrelevant for SOH estimation.

claim: Prediction failure was already upstream of fusion
metric: oracle STL reconstruction R2=1 while predicted reconstruction R2=-13.019/-13.642
allowed_wording: In this implementation and protocol, component forecast error is a necessary upstream failure layer before learned fusion.
prohibited_wording: Fusion weights are the sole root cause.

claim: GAN was not a uniform cause or remedy
metric: REAL_ONLY reconstruction RMSE=5.832 versus REAL+GAN=6.695 with mixed component effects
allowed_wording: GAN effects were battery-specific in the fixed diagnostic.
prohibited_wording: GAN always harms or always improves transfer.

claim: Complex and lightweight component replacements did not establish a remedy
metric: TimesNet/iTransformer and Ridge/tiny MLP/tiny GRU did not establish robust replacement
allowed_wording: The evaluated component replacements did not establish a robust remedy.
prohibited_wording: No alternative component model can work.

metric: mean KS=.562/.573 and stronger B0007 relationship-shift evidence
allowed_wording: HF shift is an associative upstream generalization stressor.
prohibited_wording: HF shift physically causes negative transfer.

claim: STL prefix instability was insufficient as the primary explanation
metric: prefix-stable EMA/median had no >=1 percent Ridge RMSE improvement
allowed_wording: Prefix instability alone was insufficient in the fixed diagnostic.

metric: source-only R2=.658 for B0007 versus .149 for B0018; calibrated B0007 R2=.916
allowed_wording: Transfer benefit depended on the evaluated source-target combination.
prohibited_wording: Calibrated transfer is zero-shot or universally beneficial.

metric: B0006-only zero-shot R2=-2.474/-1.905 and calibrated R2=-.683/-1.483
allowed_wording: B0006 produced negative-transfer risk for both evaluated targets in the audited source bank.
prohibited_wording: B0006 is universally unsuitable as a source battery.

claim: Unsupervised HF-distance screening did not predict utility
metric: selected B0006 for both targets and lost to all-source in all four contrasts
allowed_wording: The frozen pure-HF nearest-neighbor rule was not a valid transfer-utility score here.
prohibited_wording: A different distance formula will likely solve source selection.

claim: Prefix-supervised screening was only battery-specifically supported
allowed_wording: Prefix supervision had battery-specific utility under calibrated/few-shot transfer.
prohibited_wording: Prefix-supervised screening is a generally effective source-selection algorithm.

claim: Source compatibility remains an audit construct rather than a physical mechanism
metric: support mismatch and residual diagnostics are associative and two selection rules were unstable
allowed_wording: Source compatibility is associated with transfer risk in this audit.
prohibited_wording: Compatibility is an identified electrochemical causal mechanism.

claim: The thesis evidence is NASA-only and development/validation-stage
metric: no CALCE or independent confirmation; locked test remains unopened
allowed_wording: The thesis reports NASA development/validation evidence and preserves the locked test.
